in_marathi.name: Avitansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in infinite form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avitansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avitansh is a name derived from Sanskrit language, which means 'God in infinite form'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology, particularly in the Puranic texts where Gods are often depicted in their infinite forms. Avitansh is a powerful name that signifies the vastness and limitless nature of the divine.
